name: Sol-fa-soft Manatsu no Omotenashi CD
source:
sol-fa-soft's first CD release in 5 years! 

■ Lightly interactive title screen
Playing with Natsuki on the menu screen.

■ Solfa Grand Prize 2012
Two award-winning works are made into games.

■ Soshage de Choroin
Short story. This is a prequel to "Mizuabitch".

■ Chisana Maou Hime no Yabou
Minigame with a short story.

■ Hatsujou Kisegae
Sexy dressup game using the characters of Hatsujou Tenkousei.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE166727.html]DLsite English[/url]]
